manners.bodyEn: A Muslim is truthful and does not lie
We are kind to our parents and obey them in what is good
We smile and help those in need

manners.bodyAr: نطرق الباب ونستأذن قبل أن ندخل
manners.bodyEn: We knock and ask permission before entering

manners.bodyAr: نسمّي الله ونأكل بيميننا ومما يلينا
manners.bodyEn: We say Bismillah and eat with the right hand from what is near us
We respect our elders and are kind to the young

manners.bodyAr: نحفظ ما ائتُمنّا عليه ونردّ الأشياء إلى أصحابها
manners.bodyEn: We guard what we are trusted with and return things to their owners

manners.bodyAr: نقول: الحمد لله، ونشكر من أحسن إلينا
manners.bodyEn: We say Alhamdulillah and thank those who are kind to us
When we make a mistake we apologise and put it right

manners.bodyAr: نستمع إلى من يتحدث ولا نقاطعه
manners.bodyEn: We listen to the one speaking and do not interrupt

manners.bodyAr: نزيل الأذى من الطريق فهو صدقة
manners.bodyEn: We remove harm from the road; it is a charity

manners.bodyAr: نرفق بالحيوان ولا نؤذيه ونطعمه إن احتاج
manners.bodyEn: We are gentle with animals, never hurt them, and feed them when they are hungry
We speak good words or stay silent
